language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon begins on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The gripper closes around its handle and lifts it clear of the table (frames 64–83, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it toward the open drawer (frames 100–160, image and wrist_image). At frames 164–169, wrist_image shows the fingers opening and withdrawing while the spoon remains inside the drawer; frames 170–183 show it resting there independently of the gripper. No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
